title: Juicy Spanish Garlic Bake
description: A flavorful and juicy Spanish-inspired dish featuring garlic, potatoes, and chicken, all baked in the oven to perfection. This recipe is easy to make and perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat it dry with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flax eggs and olive oil.
Add the garlic, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and coat it evenly with the garlic mixture.
In a separate bowl, toss the potatoes with a little bit of olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the chicken breast in a baking dish and top it with the potatoes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
